messages.subject: <input class = "select">
parts:
Hi all,


I'm writing an HTML UI.R file that uses the select2 javascript plug in for a menu.  Everything displays correctly when I used the 

<input type = "select" id = "foo">

command, but the selected items do not get passed to the server via input$foo.  This plugin has worked previously if I use the

<select id = "foo>
  <option> Option 1 </option>
   ....
</select>

tags.

Do you know of a way to make it work with the <input> tag?  If not in Shiny, I presume there is a way to do it in Javascript, which I'd be happy to try if someone could point me in the right direction.

Thanks!
Ben
